en.title: Week 1
en.oneLiner: Match her real level, keep safety one leap ahead of her climbing, and stretch play past games she’s already mastered.

bigThree.title: Spot stairs & playground, especially going down
lines: Down is harder than up. Hands ready on the way down.
Stay one safety leap ahead: gates, furniture anchors, cords, pull-down hazards.
“No” isn’t a brake yet. Understanding ≠ stopping mid-climb. You are the brake.

bigThree.title: Stretch play past mastered games
lines: Ditty Bird / peekaboo / give-me = 1–2 min warm-ups only.
Then go one step harder: hide-and-find, bring-it, pull-the-scarf, container lab.
Mastery without stretch = boredom, not learning.

bigThree.title: Narrate her goals (serve & return)
lines: She acts → you answer → she continues. That loop builds brain circuits.
Talk about what she’s already doing: “You’re climbing up… two feet!”
After a scare, comfort first, then let her choose to retry.

daily: One spotted playground stretch (not only free chaos)
One next-level game (hide-find / bring-it / scarf / containers)
Quiet 5–10 min floor time after the park
todos: Safety leap-ahead: stairs, climbing, pull-down hazards

quiz.q: Keep Ditty Bird and peekaboo as the main games?
quiz.why: She’s mastered them. Use them as warm-ups, then give her the next problem.

quiz.q: Push her to walk on her own for show?
quiz.why: Cruising and stairs are already serious motor homework. Pressure adds fear, not skill.

quiz.q: Comfort after a fall, then let her choose to try again?
quiz.why: Recovery with you builds Brave. Forced retries can build fear.

quiz.q: Trust “she knows no” to keep her off the stairs?
quiz.why: Understanding no isn’t the same as stopping mid-climb. Gates and your spot are the safety.

quiz.q: Short limit + a legal climb option?
quiz.why: “No stairs alone. Yes, climb this cushion hill with me.”

quiz.q: Use screens to burn off energy?
quiz.why: Busy bodies still need real-world problem-solving more than video.

plays.name: Pull-the-scarf fishing
plays.how: Toy on a scarf; she pulls the scarf to get it.

plays.name: Dump & fill station
plays.how: Bowls, blocks, lids: in, out, dump.

plays.name: Lid lab
plays.how: Containers with easy lids on/off. You narrate, she leads.

plays.name: Hide-and-find under a cloth
plays.how: Hide a toy while she watches: “Where’s bear?” Level up: hide while she looks away for a second.

plays.name: Bring-it delivery
plays.how: “Give me” → “Put it in the bowl” → “Bring it to Mama.” Cheer the delivery.

plays.name: Laundry-basket ferry
plays.how: A basket with a book inside to push across a cleared lane.

plays.name: Stack & crash
plays.how: Stack blocks, she knocks them down on purpose.

plays.name: Drum kitchen
plays.how: Pots and wooden spoons.

plays.name: Flashlight on/off
plays.how: Supervised; she presses, you name “on / off.”

plays.name: Mirror play
plays.how: Faces and waves in a safe mirror.

plays.name: Quiet board book
plays.how: No buttons. Point and name.

plays.name: Pretend sip / phone
plays.how: Cup to lips: “Sip.” Phone to ear: “Hi!” 10–30 seconds.

plays.name: Ball to a person
plays.how: Roll a ball back and forth.

plays.name: Water wipe station
plays.how: Damp cloth to wipe a tray, supervised.

plays.name: Playground mission
plays.how: Pick ONE spotted stretch per visit, stop while she’s still happy.

scripts.when: She heads for the stairs alone

steps.say: Yes, climb this cushion hill with me!

scripts.when: I snapped at the 40th stair dash

steps.say: Mama used a loud voice. I’m sorry.

steps.do: Hug and reconnect, then hold the limit.
Short, warm goodbye. Don’t sneak off.

steps.say: Baibai slide! Time for the car.

details.title: What’s going on in her brain
lines: Balance and motor planning: how do I get up, across, down?
Means–end: “I do A to get B.” Ready for level 2–3.
Understands more than she says: names, simple “where’s ___?”
Frustration at limits is a strong body plus a big goal, not naughtiness.

details.title: Coming in the next 4–8 weeks
lines: Bolder climbing; up is easier than safe down.
Maybe brief stands without holding, maybe first steps (or later, both fine).
Tool use: stick, scarf, lids, nesting. More “I show you this.”
Bigger protests at limits; possible clinginess with strangers.

sources.label: Harvard Center on the Developing Child: Serve and Return

zh.title: 第1周
zh.oneLiner: 跟上她真实的水平，安全措施比她的攀爬早一步，把她已经玩熟的游戏升级。
now: 🧗 能扶着站起来，扶着横着走
🐦 Ditty Bird、你给我拿、躲猫猫：都玩熟了

bigThree.title: 楼梯和游乐场要护着，尤其是往下
lines: 往下比往上难。往下的时候手要随时准备好。
安全措施比她早一步：安全门、固定家具、电线、会被拉倒的东西。
“不行”还不是刹车。听得懂不等于爬到一半能停下。你才是刹车。

bigThree.title: 把玩熟的游戏升级
lines: Ditty Bird / 躲猫猫 / 给我 = 只当1–2分钟热身。
然后难一步：找藏起来的玩具、送东西、拉围巾、容器实验。
只玩会的、不加挑战，是无聊，不是学习。

bigThree.title: 说出她想做的事（你来我往）
lines: 她做 → 你回应 → 她继续。这个循环在搭建大脑回路。
说她正在做的事：“你在往上爬……两只脚！”
吓到或摔了以后，先安慰，再让她自己决定要不要再试。

daily: 游乐场做一次有人护着的小挑战（不只是乱跑）
一个升级游戏（找藏的玩具 / 送东西 / 拉围巾 / 容器）
一次楼梯课或推车练习
公园回来后，安静地在地上玩5–10分钟
一次语言练习：“___在哪儿？”或送东西
todos: 安全早一步：楼梯、攀爬、会被拉倒的东西
读一遍“你来我往”的理念

quiz.q: 把 Ditty Bird 和躲猫猫当主要游戏？
quiz.why: 她已经玩熟了。当热身就好，然后给她下一个难题。

quiz.q: 为了给人看，逼她自己走路？
quiz.why: 扶着走和爬楼梯已经是很重的运动功课了。施压只会添恐惧，不会添本事。

quiz.q: 摔了先安慰，再让她自己决定要不要再试？
quiz.why: 有你陪着缓过来，她才会变勇敢。逼她再试可能会让她害怕。

quiz.q: 相信“她懂不行”，就能让她不上楼梯？
quiz.why: 懂“不行”不等于爬到一半能停。安全门和你的保护才是安全。

quiz.q: 简短的规则 + 一个可以爬的选择？
quiz.why: “不能自己上楼梯。可以，跟妈妈一起爬这个靠垫山。”
精力旺盛的身体，更需要在真实世界里动手解决问题，而不是看视频。

plays.name: 拉围巾钓玩具
plays.how: 玩具放在围巾上，她拉围巾就能拿到。

plays.name: 倒出来、装进去
plays.how: 碗、积木、盖子：放进去、拿出来、倒掉。

plays.name: 盖子实验室
plays.how: 盖子好开的容器，盖上又打开。你来说，她来主导。

plays.name: 布下面找玩具
plays.how: 当着她的面把玩具藏在布下：“小熊在哪儿？”升级：趁她转头一秒时藏。

plays.name: 送东西
plays.how: “给我” → “放进碗里” → “拿给妈妈”。送到了就欢呼。

plays.name: 洗衣篮摆渡
plays.how: 篮子里放本书，推着穿过清空的通道。

plays.name: 搭了再推倒
plays.how: 搭积木，让她故意推倒。

plays.name: 厨房打鼓
plays.how: 锅和木勺。

plays.name: 手电筒开开关关
plays.how: 大人看着；她来按，你说“开 / 关”。

plays.name: 照镜子
plays.how: 在安全的镜子前做鬼脸、挥挥手。

plays.name: 安静的硬纸板书
plays.how: 没有按钮的书。指一指，说名字。

plays.name: 假装喝水 / 打电话
plays.how: 杯子放嘴边：“喝。”电话放耳边：“喂！”10–30秒就够。

plays.name: 把球滚给人
plays.how: 来回滚球。

plays.name: 擦水小站
plays.how: 用湿布擦托盘，大人在旁边看着。

plays.name: 游乐场任务
plays.how: 每次只挑一个有人护着的小挑战，趁她还开心时就停。

steps.say: 停。上楼梯要和妈妈一起。
可以，跟妈妈一起爬这个靠垫山！

scripts.when: 她第40次冲向楼梯，我发火了

steps.say: 妈妈刚才声音太大了。对不起。

steps.do: 抱抱她，重新连接，然后坚持规则。
简短、温暖地告别。别偷偷溜走。

details.title: 她的大脑在忙什么
lines: 平衡和动作计划：我怎么上去、过去、下来？
手段和目的：“我做A就能得到B。”可以玩更难一点的了。
她懂的比说的多：名字、简单的“___在哪儿？”
被拦住就发脾气，是身体有劲加上想法很大，不是调皮。

details.title: 接下来4–8周
lines: 攀爬更大胆；往上比安全地往下容易。
可能会短暂地不扶站，可能迈出第一步（也可能晚一点，都正常）。
开始用工具：棍子、围巾、盖子、套杯。更多“给你看这个”。
被拦住时抗议更大；见生人可能更黏人。
